def test_carts_add_update_delete():
    customer_id = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_payload = {
        "username": customer_id,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{customer_id}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)

    # Get catalogue to get a real item ID
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) > 0, "Catalogue is empty"
    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    unit_price = items[0]["price"]

    # Add item to cart
    item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 1,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item in cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) == 1
    assert cart_items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert cart_items[0]["quantity"] == 1

    # Update item quantity
    item_payload["quantity"] = 3
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify updated quantity
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 3

    # Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Delete cart
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart deleted (items should be empty)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0, "Cart should be empty after deletion"

def test_carts_merge():
    customer_id = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    session_id = f"sess_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    user_payload = {
        "username": customer_id,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{customer_id}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)

    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    items = resp.json()
    item_id = items[0]["id"]
    unit_price = items[0]["price"]

    item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": unit_price
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{session_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Merge session cart into customer cart
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={session_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify customer cart has the item
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cart_items = resp.json()
    assert len(cart_items) >= 1
    assert any(item["itemId"] == item_id for item in cart_items)

    # Merge with non-existent session cart -> 404
    bad_session = f"bad_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/merge?sessionId={bad_session}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_user_registration_and_login():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    email = f"{username}@example.com"

    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": email,
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }

    # Register
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify customer exists
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Register again -> 409
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Login success
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Login fail
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, "wrongpass"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 401, f"Expected 401, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_catalogue_queries():
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags_data = resp.json()
    assert "tags" in tags_data
    tags = tags_data["tags"]

    if tags:
        tag = tags[0]
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/size?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        size_data = resp.json()
        assert "size" in size_data

        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue?tags={tag}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        items = resp.json()
        assert isinstance(items, list)
        if items:
            item_id = items[0]["id"]
            resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
            assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

            image_urls = items[0].get("imageUrl", [])
            if image_urls:
                image_path = image_urls[0].split("/")[-1]
                resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/images/{image_path}"), timeout=10)
                assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Negative test
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue/nonexistent-id-123"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

def test_shipping_creation():

    assert shipment.get("orderId") == order_id

    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment_get = resp.json()
    assert shipment_get.get("orderId") == order_id
    assert shipment_get.get("trackingNumber") == shipment.get("trackingNumber")

def test_user_addresses_and_cards():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    user_payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": "password",
        "email": f"{username}@example.com",
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=user_payload, timeout=10)

    address_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "EC1A 1BB",
        "street": "Test Street",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=address_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "Test Street" in resp.text, "Address should be present in the response"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert "1234567890123456" in resp.text, "Card should be present in the response"

    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/customers"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert username not in resp.text, f"Customer {username} should have been deleted"
